authors.bio: Christopher P. Daubney was educated at Clifton College, Bristol, and St. John's College, Cambridge. He joined the BBC in 1964 and worked in various departments including Studio and Outside Broadcast Operations, as a Lecturer in Engineering Training, and as a Planning and Installation Engineer in Capital Projects. In 1973, he joined the IBA as the Principal Engineer in Quality Control Section and is now Head of Quality Control. In April, 1984, he will become head of the IBA's Engineering Information Service.
